description: AFIS - Geodätisches Festpunktfeld Land Bremen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi1.geo.bremen.de. Web Map Service (WMS) AFIS - Geodetic fixed point field Land Bremen. The spatial reference of the official surveying system in Germany is realized by a uniform, homogeneous fixed point field throughout Germany. This consists of the Geodetic Base Network Points (GGP), Altitude Fixed Points (HFP), Gravity Fixed Points (SFP) and Reference Station Points (RSP). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS AFIS - Geodetic fixed point field Land Bremen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS, Höhenfestpunkte, Aufnahmepunkte, Lagefestpunkte, Amtliche Festpunkte, Schwerefestpunkte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
